title: Choose the visual world for design-system.wpei.me
question: The roll assigned The Card Catalogue. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. This world becomes the look the docs and /playground inherit.

options.label: The Card Catalogue
options.lineage: steel library card cabinets, 3×5 index cards, typed main entries and guide-card tabs
options.thesis: Every record is a 3×5 card: its face shows the main entry, and everything else is a tracing you pull for.
materials: steel drawer with a label holder
options.viewport: An open drawer from above: the front card holds the name at poster size, the purpose as the card note and 'In process' as its status; guide-card tabs behind it name the rule areas; the red 'Watch on GitHub' is the only red on the page; the live state card starts below.
options.risk: Reads as library nostalgia if the cards turn cream or the typewriter face spreads past the cards; the cards stay white and the cabinet stays steel.

raised.raise: Every block sits on the index card's ruling: one baseline grid derived from the 3×5 card governs the whole page.
The demo card's state lives in the URL (?state=partial), so every state is a shareable link.
Each demonstrated state sits beside the rule that produced it and that rule's source, as paired views.
Withheld and loading fields keep their exact footprint on the card; nothing collapses when data is missing.
One deliberate scale break: the front card's main entry at poster size against 13px typed card text.

options.label: The Disclosure Release
options.lineage: documents released in part under freedom-of-information requests
options.thesis: The site as a document released in part: every withheld field is a bar whose margin code cites the rule that withheld it.
options.viewport: One released page: the header stamp, the purpose paragraph with the unbuilt parts barred, margin codes linking to Linear and Primer, and 'remaining pages pending review' in place of 'coming soon'.
options.risk: Redaction is a familiar privacy-product look with surveillance connotations, and it implies the content is secret when it is only unbuilt.

options.label: The HyperCard Stack
options.lineage: HyperCard stacks on one-bit Macintosh screens
options.thesis: The design system as a one-bit stack: each rule is a card, each source a button that flips to it.
options.viewport: A home card centred under a pixel menu bar: the name, the purpose line, rule-area buttons, and the state card one button away.
options.case: Fuses well: one-bit plus one accent matches the brand commitment exactly and 'card' is the product's own noun; loses on clarity because a stack hides the offer behind navigation.
options.risk: Reads as Mac nostalgia, and fixed card proportions fight the long docs pages that come next.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.thesis: States as traces on one graticule.
options.viewport: One graticule with the state traces overlaid.
options.case: Fuses poorly: phosphor green breaks monochrome-plus-one-accent, and developers do not read disclosure rules as signals.
options.risk: An instrument costume on a docs site.

options.label: Gravity-Rain Garden
options.thesis: Rules as local gravities that route data.
options.viewport: A garden where data falls toward its rule.
options.case: Fuses poorly: colour-coded gravity contradicts the single accent, and the metaphor hides what the components do.

options.label: Curved-Crease Shell
options.thesis: One rule-line folds flat data into structure.
options.viewport: A disc folding along one arc.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a sculptural paper study says nothing to developers about rows, cards and states.
options.risk: Cream paper and italic serif: the default look.

options.label: Couture Doll Atelier
options.thesis: Components as numbered looks on a runway.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the audience does not identify with couture, and blush plus gold breaks the monochrome commitment.

options.label: Tropicália Sleeve
options.thesis: Components pasted at mismatched scales into one tableau.
options.case: Fuses poorly: saturated full palette breaks the brand, and deliberate disorder contradicts a system about ordering data.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A shadcn-style launch page: centred headline, 'Coming soon' badge, Star on GitHub, three feature cards.
canonCard.viewport: A dark centred hero with a badge, the headline, the purpose line and a GitHub button, three cards for the rule areas below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other shadcn registry by design.
